readme.excerpt: Implement model internals, retrieval pipelines, and agent runtimes. Test them, inspect failures, and keep the code and evaluation results. Start learning · Choose a path · Try a lab · Build a project · Browse the curriculum Free, open source, MIT. Learn on the website, with a coding agent, or by running local code. 542 lessons. 20 phases. Python, TypeScript, Rust, Julia, Go. See all supporters · Become a sponsor Why build it from scratch A framework call hides the part that breaks. When a loss turns into NaN or an agent repeats the same tool call, the person who wrote the small version knows where to look. Most lessons have you write that small version first and run it, then show where production tools do the same work. Text version - 01 · THE
